system.description: System configuration (v2.1) - Decouples logical roles from measurements

speakers.description:
Map of channel name to speaker configuration
In v2.1 with `system` config, keys here are "measurement keys" referenced by `system.speakers`.
In legacy mode, keys are logical channel names.

crossovers.description: Optional crossover configuration for multi-driver groups

recording_config.description: Recording configuration (device settings, signal parameters used during capture)

SystemConfig.description: Explicit system configuration mapping logical roles to measurements

speakers.description:
Map of logical role to measurement key
Key: Logical role (e.g., "L", "R", "C", "LFE")
Value: Key in the `speakers` measurement map (e.g., "left", "right")

crossover.description: Crossover reference key (points to entry in `crossovers` map)

oneOf.description: Single subwoofer optimization (default)
Multi-Sub Optimizer (minimize seat-to-seat variance)
Double Bass Array (active cancellation)

SpeakerConfig.description:
Speaker configuration (can be single measurement or group)

Variant order matters for serde untagged deserialization: serde tries each variant
in order. Group/MultiSub/Dba all require a `name` field that `MeasurementSource`
doesn't have, so they are tried first. `Single` is last as a catch-all.

SpeakerGroup.description: Group of measurements for a single speaker (multi-driver)

MeasurementSource.description: Source of measurements (single file, multiple files for averaging, or in-memory curve)

anyOf.description: A single measurement file with optional speaker name
Multiple measurement files to be averaged with optional speaker name

MeasurementSingle.description:
Single measurement with metadata

Custom implementation to support both string path and object with speaker_name

anyOf.description: Inline measurement data (stored directly in JSON)

path.description: Path to the CSV measurement file.

name.description: Optional display name for the measurement.

anyOf.description: Path to CSV file (freq, spl, phase columns)

wav_path.description: Optional path to associated WAV file

csv_path.description: Optional path to associated CSV file

allpass_optimization.description:
Enable per-subwoofer all-pass filter optimization.
When true, optimizes gain + delay + all-pass biquad per sub for improved
phase alignment and mode cancellation. Uses DE global optimizer.
Default: false (standard gain + delay only)

CardioidConfig.description: Configuration for Gradient Cardioid Subwoofer (2 subwoofers)

separation_meters.description: Physical separation distance in meters (between acoustic centers)

frequencies.description:
Crossover frequencies in Hz (for 3-way and above)
e.g., [500, 3000] for woofer/mid at 500Hz, mid/tweeter at 3000Hz

anyOf.description: Path to CSV file (freq, spl columns)

mode.description:
Optimization mode: "iir" (default), "fir", "mixed"
(Legacy field, prefer `processing_mode` in v2)

mixed_config.description:
Mixed mode configuration (frequency-based crossover)
When mode == "mixed" and this is Some, uses frequency-based crossover
(FIR on one band, IIR on the other). When None, uses legacy sequential mode.

mixed_phase.description:
Mixed-phase correction configuration.
Used when processing_mode = MixedPhase. Decomposes measurement into
minimum-phase (IIR) and excess phase (short FIR).

num_filters.description: Number of PEQ filters per channel

seed.description:
Random seed for reproducible results (None for random)
When set, the optimizer will produce deterministic results

refine.description:
Whether to run local refinement after global optimization (hybrid optimization)
When true, runs a two-stage optimization:
  Stage 1 (Global): DE finds approximate solution
  Stage 2 (Local): COBYLA fine-tunes the result
Default: true (recommended for best results)

local_algo.description:
Local optimizer algorithm for refinement stage
Used when `refine` is true. Default: "cobyla"

psychoacoustic.description:
Enable psychoacoustic preprocessing
When true, applies variable smoothing before optimization:
- 1/48 octave smoothing < 100 Hz (preserve room modes)
- 1/6 octave smoothing > 1 kHz (ignore comb filtering)

Default: true (recommended for room correction)

smooth_n.description:
Loss function smoothing resolution as 1/N octave.
Lower values = broader smoothing = optimizer ignores narrower features.
Range: 1..48 (1 = 1/1 octave, 2 = 1/2 octave, 48 = 1/48 octave).
Default: 2 (1/2 octave)

asymmetric_loss.description:
Enable asymmetric loss (peaks penalized 2x more than dips)
When true, the optimizer will prioritize reducing peaks over filling dips,
which is psychoacoustically correct since nulls cannot be fixed with EQ.
Default: true (recommended for room correction)

allow_delay.description:
Allow inter-speaker delay optimization
When true, the optimizer generates delay plugins to align speakers in time.
This includes time alignment from WAV measurements, phase alignment, and group delay optimization.
Default: false for IIR mode (low-latency), true for FIR and mixed modes.
When None (omitted from JSON), the default is inferred from the mode.

target_response.description: Unified target response configuration (preferred over legacy target_tilt + broadband)

target_tilt.description: Legacy target curve tilt configuration — migrated to `target_response` at load time

excursion_protection.description:
Excursion protection configuration
Auto-generates HPF to prevent over-boost on bookshelf speakers

schroeder_split.description:
Schroeder frequency split configuration
Different Q constraints below/above Schroeder frequency

phase_alignment.description: Phase alignment configuration for subwoofer integration

broadband_target_matching.description:
Broadband target matching configuration (v2.1)
Fits shelf filters to match target curve across full spectrum before fine EQ

multi_measurement.description:
Multi-measurement optimization configuration
When a speaker has multiple measurements (different listening positions),
controls how they are combined during optimization.

decomposed_correction.description:
Decomposed correction configuration.
When set, applies frequency-dependent correction weights based on acoustic
decomposition: room modes get aggressive correction, steady-state response
gets gentle correction, early reflections get reduced correction.

cea2034_correction.description:
CEA2034 speaker pre-correction configuration.
When enabled, fetches anechoic speaker data from spinorama.org and generates
correction filters for frequencies above the Schroeder frequency.
This is Pass 1 of the 3-pass optimization pipeline:
  Pass 1: Speaker correction (above Schroeder)
  Pass 2: Room EQ correction (standard room correction on residual)
  Pass 3: User preference (bass/treble shelves)

sub_config.description:
Subwoofer-specific optimizer overrides.
When present, sub/LFE channels use these parameters instead of the global ones.

channel_matching.description:
Inter-channel consistency correction configuration.
Post-hoc PEQ correction to bring all channels to similar SPL across midrange.

ProcessingMode.description: Processing mode for the optimization engine

oneOf.description: Low-latency mode (IIR filters only) - < 5ms latency
Phase-linear mode (FIR filters only) - High latency allowed
Hybrid mode (IIR for bass, FIR for mids/highs) - Variable latency

Mixed-phase mode (IIR for minimum-phase + short FIR for excess phase)
Requires phase data in measurements. Low latency (~10ms).

correct_excess_phase.description:
Whether to correct excess phase (only applies to kirkeby mode)
When true, corrects both magnitude and excess phase (requires clean phase measurements).
When false (default), only corrects magnitude (produces linear-phase FIR, more robust).

phase_smoothing.description:
Phase smoothing width in octaves (default: 0.167 = 1/6 octave)
Applied via group delay smoothing when excess phase correction is enabled.
Smoothing reduces noise artifacts in phase measurements.
Set to 0.0 to disable smoothing.

pre_ringing.description:
Pre-ringing suppression configuration.
When set, FIR filter pre-ringing is constrained to the specified threshold.

PreRingingSerdeConfig.description: Serializable pre-ringing configuration for JSON config files.

threshold_db.description: Maximum pre-ringing level in dB relative to main tap. Default: -30.0

max_time_s.description: Maximum pre-ringing time in seconds. Default: 0.005 (5 ms)

MixedModeConfig.description:
Configuration for frequency-based mixed mode crossover

When specified with mode="mixed", the optimizer will use different filter types
for different frequency bands separated by a crossover frequency.

crossover_freq.description: Crossover frequency dividing IIR and FIR bands (Hz)

fir_band.description:
Which band uses FIR: "low" or "high" (default: "low")
FIR is typically better for low frequencies (bass room modes)

MixedPhaseSerdeConfig.description: Serializable mixed-phase correction configuration for JSON config files.

max_fir_length_ms.description: Maximum FIR length in milliseconds for excess phase correction. Default: 10.0

min_spatial_depth.description: Minimum spatial correction depth for excess phase correction. Default: 0.5

phase_smoothing_octaves.description: Phase smoothing width in octaves. Default: 1/6 octave

TargetResponseConfig.description:
Unified target response configuration for room correction.

Defines both the target shape (what the corrected response should look like)
and user preference adjustments (bass/treble tweaks on top).
All processing stages (broadband pre-correction, EQ optimization, scoring)
use this single target, eliminating double-application bugs.

Replaces the legacy `target_tilt` + `broadband_target_matching` combination.

slope_db_per_octave.description:
Slope in dB per octave (used when shape == Custom).
Negative = downward tilt toward high frequencies.

reference_freq.description: Reference frequency where target shape equals 0 dB (Hz)

curve_path.description: Path to custom target curve CSV (used when shape == File)

preference.description: User preference adjustments (layered ON TOP of the target shape)

broadband_precorrection.description:
Enable broadband pre-correction (shelf+gain fit before fine EQ).
When true, fits gentle shelves to align the measurement with the
target shape BEFORE the optimizer places narrow PEQ filters.
Default: false (only enabled when explicitly set or via legacy migration)

TargetShape.description:
Target response shape preset.

Defines the overall shape of the corrected in-room frequency response.

oneOf.description: Flat in-room response (no tilt)
Harman preferred in-room curve (-0.8 dB/octave from 1 kHz reference)
Custom slope specified by `slope_db_per_octave`
Load target curve from external CSV file (`curve_path` must be set)

UserPreference.description:
User preference adjustments layered on top of the target shape.

These are additive dB adjustments relative to the target.
Example: shape=Harman + bass_shelf_db=+3 means Harman curve
with an extra 3 dB bass boost below 200 Hz.

bass_shelf_db.description: Bass shelf boost/cut in dB (applied below `bass_shelf_freq`)

treble_shelf_db.description: Treble shelf boost/cut in dB (applied above `treble_shelf_freq`)

TargetTiltConfig.description:
Target curve tilt configuration

Applies a frequency-dependent tilt to the target curve instead of flat.
Harman-style tilt (-0.8 dB/octave) is psychoacoustically preferred for in-room listening.

tilt_type.description: Tilt type: flat, harman, or custom

slope_db_per_octave.description:
Slope in dB per octave (negative = downward tilt towards high frequencies)
Default: -0.8 for Harman-style tilt

reference_freq.description:
Reference frequency where tilt equals 0 dB (Hz)
Default: 1000.0 Hz

bass_shelf_db.description:
Bass shelf boost in dB (applied below bass_shelf_freq)
Default: 0.0 (no additional bass boost)

bass_shelf_freq.description:
Bass shelf frequency in Hz
Default: 200.0 Hz

TiltType.description: Target curve tilt type for room correction

oneOf.description: Flat target (no tilt)
Harman-style tilt (-0.8 dB/octave with bass shelf)
Custom tilt with user-specified parameters

ExcursionProtectionConfig.description:
Excursion protection configuration

Detects the speaker's F3 rolloff point and automatically generates a highpass filter
to prevent dangerous over-boost of bass frequencies on bookshelf speakers.

manual_f3_hz.description: Manual F3 override in Hz (used if auto_detect_f3 is false)

margin_octaves.description:
Safety margin in octaves below F3 for HPF placement
Default: 0.25 (HPF placed at F3 * 2^(-0.25))

HighpassType.description: Highpass filter type for excursion protection

oneOf.description: Linkwitz-Riley (4th order = 24dB/oct)
Butterworth

SchroederSplitConfig.description:
Schroeder frequency split configuration

Different Q constraints below and above the Schroeder frequency.
Below Schroeder: high-Q narrow filters to address room modes
Above Schroeder: low-Q broad filters for gentle tone control

schroeder_freq.description:
Schroeder frequency in Hz
Default: 300.0 Hz (typical for small/medium rooms)

RoomDimensions.description: Room dimensions for automatic Schroeder frequency calculation

LowFreqFilterConfig.description: Low frequency filter configuration for Schroeder split

max_q.description: Maximum Q factor for low frequency filters (allow high-Q for modes)

allow_boost.description:
Allow boost (true) or cuts only (false)
Default: false (cuts only for low frequencies)

max_db.description:
Maximum boost/cut in dB for below-Schroeder filters.
Room modes can be 15+ dB, so this allows wider range than the global max_db.
When None, uses the optimizer's global max_db.

HighFreqFilterConfig.description: High frequency filter configuration for Schroeder split

max_q.description: Maximum Q factor for high frequency filters (tone controls only)

PhaseAlignmentConfig.description:
Phase alignment configuration for subwoofer integration

Optimizes delay and polarity to maximize energy sum in the crossover region
between subwoofer and main speakers.

MultiSeatConfig.description:
Multi-seat optimization configuration

Optimizes subwoofer delays and gains to minimize response variance
across multiple listening positions.

primary_seat.description: Index of primary seat (0-based, used with PrimaryWithConstraints strategy)

max_deviation_db.description: Maximum allowed deviation at non-primary seats (dB, used with PrimaryWithConstraints)

oneOf.description: Minimize standard deviation across all seats (default)
Optimize for primary seat with constraints on others
Optimize for average response across all seats

target_ms.description:
Target group delay at crossover (ms)
Default: 0.0 ms (perfect alignment)

VoiceOfGodConfig.description: Configuration for Voice of God (Timbre Matching)

BroadbandTargetMatchingConfig.description:
Configuration for broadband target matching

Fits Low Shelf, High Shelf, and Gain filters to match the target curve
across the full frequency range (20Hz-20kHz) before fine-grained PEQ optimization.
This provides broad tonal balance correction even if fine EQ is limited to a smaller range.

weights.description: Weights for WeightedSum (normalized internally). Equal if omitted.

variance_lambda.description: Lambda for VariancePenalized (default 1.0). Higher = more consistent across positions.

spatial_robustness.description: Spatial robustness configuration (used when strategy = SpatialRobustness).

MultiMeasurementStrategy.description: Strategy for handling multiple measurements per speaker

oneOf.description: RMS-average curves, optimize on average (existing behavior)
loss = Σ w_i * loss_i — weighted sum of per-measurement losses
loss = max(loss_i) — optimize worst case across all measurements
loss = mean(loss_i) + λ * var(loss_i) — balance quality + consistency

Spatial robustness: RMS-average + correction depth mask based on spatial variance.
Only corrects features consistent across positions.

SpatialRobustnessSerdeConfig.description: Serializable spatial robustness configuration for JSON config files.

variance_threshold_db.description: Variance threshold (dB) below which full correction is allowed. Default: 3.0

transition_width_db.description: Transition width (dB) for sigmoid blending. Default: 2.0

mask_smoothing_octaves.description: Smoothing width in octaves for the correction depth mask. Default: 1/6 octave.

DecomposedCorrectionSerdeConfig.description:
Serializable decomposed correction configuration for JSON config files.

When enabled, applies frequency-dependent correction weights:
room modes (below Schroeder) get full correction, steady-state response
(above Schroeder) gets gentle correction, position-dependent features get reduced correction.

schroeder_freq.description:
Schroeder frequency (Hz). Below: modal, above: statistical.
Default: 200.0

min_mode_q.description: Minimum Q to qualify as a room mode. Default: 3.0

min_mode_prominence_db.description: Minimum prominence (dB) for mode detection. Default: 3.0

mode_correction_weight.description: Correction weight for detected room modes (0.0-1.0). Default: 1.0

early_reflection_weight.description: Correction weight for early reflections (0.0-1.0). Default: 0.3

steady_state_weight.description: Correction weight for steady-state above Schroeder (0.0-1.0). Default: 0.5

Cea2034CorrectionConfig.description:
CEA2034 speaker pre-correction configuration.

When enabled, fetches anechoic measurement data from spinorama.org for the
configured speaker and generates correction filters for frequencies above the
Schroeder frequency. Below Schroeder, the room dominates and speaker correction
is not applied.

This is Pass 1 of the 3-pass optimization pipeline.

speaker_name.description: Speaker name on spinorama.org (overrides speaker_name from MeasurementSource)

listening_distance_m.description:
Manual listening distance override in meters.
When None and mode=Auto, computed from arrival_time - system_latency.

system_latency_ms.description:
System round-trip latency in ms (for distance computation from impulse response).
Subtract this from arrival_time_ms to get acoustic propagation time only.

nearfield_threshold_m.description:
Distance threshold in meters for auto mode switch (default: 2.0m).
Below this: flat LW correction. At or above: speaker-score optimization.

min_freq.description:
Override minimum correction frequency in Hz (Schroeder frequency).
Below this frequency, speaker correction is skipped (room dominates).
If None, uses the Schroeder frequency from schroeder_split config, or 300 Hz.

num_filters.description: Number of PEQ filters for speaker correction (default: 5)

max_db.description: Maximum boost in dB (default: 3.0, allows limited boosts)

Cea2034CorrectionMode.description:
Correction mode for CEA2034 speaker pre-correction.

The optimal strategy depends on listening distance:
- Nearfield (<2m): direct sound dominates → correct Listening Window toward flat
- Farfield (>=2m): room interaction matters → optimize full Harman preference score

oneOf.description: Correct Listening Window toward flat (best for nearfield <2m)
Optimize full Harman speaker preference score using all CEA2034 curves
Auto-select based on estimated listening distance from impulse response

SubOptimizerConfig.description:
Subwoofer-specific optimizer overrides.

Subwoofers deal with dense room modes that can be 15+ dB. They need more
filters and wider dB range than main speakers. When present, these values
override the global OptimizerConfig for channels identified as subwoofers.

num_filters.description: Number of PEQ filters for subwoofer channels

max_db.description: Maximum boost in dB (room gain can be 15+ dB at resonances)

max_q.description: Maximum Q factor (higher Q for narrow room modes)

ChannelMatchingConfig.description:
Inter-channel consistency correction configuration.

After independent per-channel EQ optimization, channels may have residual
SPL differences at specific frequencies. This post-hoc correction pass adds
a small number of parametric filters per channel to reduce the deviation
from the group average.

threshold_db.description: ICD RMS threshold in dB below which no correction is applied

max_filters.description: Maximum number of additional PEQ filters per channel for matching

RecordingConfiguration.description:
Recording configuration stored with measurements
Contains device settings and signal parameters used during measurement capture

signal_type.description: Signal type used for measurements (e.g., "Sweep", "Pink Noise")

sweep_start_freq.description: Sweep start frequency in Hz (only applicable when signal_type is "Sweep")

sweep_end_freq.description: Sweep end frequency in Hz (only applicable when signal_type is "Sweep")
